description.content:
The response includes key fields with the following meanings:

**cloudKeyUnlockToken**: returns the unlock token authorized to unlock the specified entries.

**apiUrl**: returns the URL that, if POST-ed to, will immediately unlock the specified entries. E.g. curl -XPOST https://api.openpath.com/tokens/....../use immediately unlocks the specified entries.

**fullWebUrl**: returns the URL that if launched in a web browser will display a "Tap to Unlock an Entry:" set of buttons for each entry specified. E.g. browser browse to https://control.openpath.com/cloudKeyUnlock?token=......

**webUrl**: same functionality as fullWebUrl but uses a shortCode as the authorizing credential. This can be better for manual typing or other use-cases where a shorter URL provides value. E.g. browser browse to https://control.openpath.com/cloudKeyUnlock?shortCode=......
